name: release-1.31.9
body:
[nginx-1.31.9](https://nginx.org/en/download.html) mainline version has been released, with vulnerability fixes for [use-after-free](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) in resolver (CVE-2026-123634), [memory corruption](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) in HTTP/2 flow control (CVE-2026-123007), [use-after-free](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) in HTTP/3 (CVE-2026-121810), [use-after-free](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) in HTTP/2 (CVE-2026-123633), [infinite loop](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) while reading client request body over TLS 1.3 (CVE-2026-118899), [use-after-free](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) in mail proxy module (CVE-2026-113425), [NULL pointer dereference](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) when using PROXY protocol version 2 (CVE-2026-120993), [buffer overflow](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) when using alias with try_files (CVE-2026-125283), [SNI bypass](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) in client certificate validation in stream module (CVE-2026-120967), and [insufficient validation](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) in stream ssl_preread module (CVE-2026-123640).

See official [CHANGES](https://nginx.org/en/CHANGES) on nginx.org.

Below is a release summary generated by GitHub.

## What's Changed
* Version bump by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1891
* Limit conn: fixed counter leak on memory allocation errors by @dekobon in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1869
* Proxy: use zero Content-Length while discarding request body by @dekobon in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1862
* Core: made initgroups() failures fatal by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1833
* SSL: explicitly clear the session staging buffer by @ac000 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1812
* HTTP/3: fix QPACK static table values to match RFC 9204 by @Nexory in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1895
* Disabled handling of headers without a colon by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1904
* Fixed $cookie_ after a cookie without a name by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1910
* Control API: fixed handling of oversized requests by @daewoo1109 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1924
* HTTP/2: output queue fixes by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1890
* HTTP/2: Ignore unknown flags in the SETTINGS message by @marek-ludha in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1795
* Request body: flood detection for chunked request body by @sbhowmikf5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1619
* Control API: warn in single process mode only if API is enabled by @piotrp in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1898
* GeoIP: rejected out-of-range coordinates from MMDB lookups. by @u5surf in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1908
* OCSP: removed padding and preserved sign of serial in cache keys by @bavshin-f5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1927
* Index: fixed handling of non-cacheable variables. by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1940
* Map: fixed regex pattern lifetime by @arut in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1947
* Updated zlib used for win32 builds by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1953

## New Contributors
* @Nexory made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1895
* @marek-ludha made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1795
* @piotrp made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1898
* @u5surf made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1908

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nginx/nginx/compare/release-1.31.8...release-1.31.9
